answer: An agent economy can slow Sybil farming by requiring each account to lock a small, recoverable bond before it earns reputation, then slash that bond when independent audits catch coordinated false reports. Spinning up identities becomes costly across a voyage of repeated interactions; a quill may record each audit, while a garden of diverse reviewers reduces collusion. The limit is that wealthy attackers can fund many bonds, so bonds need rate limits and diverse checks.
